items.name: tokens
items.title: Company OS tokens
items.description: The required token set (shadcn + success, warning, info, field) with sample values, the cn helper, and the Inertia navigation seam every component imports.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: Sidebar left, thin header, content below. The one layout every signed-in page renders in. One job: Hold the sidebar, the header and the page in the one frame the product has.

items.name: app-sidebar
items.title: AppSidebar
items.description: Logo, New, favorites, permission-gated groups, user menu. Collapses to icons. One job: Put every page one click away, in the order people work.

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: The nav list as data. One array of gated groups drives the sidebar, the section nav, the palette and the g-keys. One job: Declare every page once, with its permission, icon, tour key and go-key.

items.name: app-header
items.title: AppHeader
items.description: A thin bar: sidebar trigger left, then trigger · search · locale · bell. Nothing else. One job: Hold the three global controls without stealing the page title.

items.name: quick-create
items.title: QuickCreate
items.description: The one global New menu, top of the sidebar. Items the user may create, nothing else. One job: Create any record from anywhere in two keystrokes.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description: One ⌘K dialog that finds records, runs actions and goes to pages. The server searches; the nav list supplies Go to. One job: Reach any record, verb or page from the keyboard in one box.

items.name: shortcut-help
items.title: ShortcutHelp
items.description: The ? sheet. Every key the shell answers to, grouped, with the go-keys generated from the nav. One job: Show the keyboard once so people stop using the mouse.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: NotificationBell
items.description: The header bell. A count badge, then a Sheet with the work waiting for you and the recent activity. One job: Tell one person what needs them now and what just happened.

items.name: locale-switch
items.title: LocaleSwitch
items.description: A globe with the current language code. Pick another and the page reloads in it. One job: Switch the interface language in one click from any page.

items.name: section-layout
items.title: SectionLayout
items.description: Title, grouped inner nav on the left, page on the right. Setup, Organization and Settings open in it. One job: Give a section with many pages one place to switch between them.

items.name: app-tour
items.title: AppTour
items.description: One short overlay tour over the shell, once per user. Hidden targets are skipped by size. One job: Walk a new user through navigation, New and search in under a minute.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: The one h1 of a page, with its own create and export actions on the right. One job: Name the page and hold the actions that belong to the whole page.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: FilterBar
items.description: Search, inline filters, an overflow popover, and removable chips. The query string is the state. One job: Narrow one index table from the URL, one field per filterable column.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: The index table frame: sticky header, scrolling rows, pager footer, and an empty state that keeps the table. One job: Frame one paginated table so it fills the page and always shows the shape the data will take.

items.name: cells
items.title: Cells
items.description: One cell per data kind. Laravel formats, the cell only places. One job: Render one typed value in one table cell, aligned and styled for its kind.

items.name: pill
items.title: Pill
items.description: A tinted label for a status, a stage or a count. The tint is the colour; there is no dot. One job: State one status or category in one word.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: An icon chip, why the region is empty, and the first action. For regions that are not tables. One job: Say why a region is empty and what fills it.

items.name: tab-nav
items.title: TabNav
items.description: Tabs that are routes. The active tab comes from the URL, never from state. One job: Switch between the sections of one record or one area, each on its own URL.

items.name: actions-menu
items.title: ActionsMenu
items.description: The "…" menu for a row or a record header. Destructive items in rose, dialogs opened by state. One job: Hold the secondary and destructive actions of one record.

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: StatTile
items.description: One number with its label, unit and hint. Quiet by default, raised glass above a list. One job: State one figure the server computed.

items.name: activity-timeline
items.title: ActivityTimeline
items.description: The audit log as a timeline: day groups, kind icon, actor, from → to pills, the reason. One job: Show the history of one record, or of everything, as the audit log recorded it.

items.name: detail-card
items.title: DetailCard
items.description: A record readout: a titled glass card of label and value pairs. Main facts left, fixed facts right. One job: State a set of labelled facts about one record.

items.name: form-layout
items.title: FormLayout
items.description: The full-page form: sticky header with Cancel and Save, section cards left, small fixed-field cards right. One job: Lay out a create or edit page with more than five fields.

items.name: field-row
items.title: FieldRow
items.description: Label, control, hint, error. Plus the form's error summary and its Cancel. One job: Wrap one form control with its persistent label and its server error.

items.name: list-skeleton
items.title: ListSkeleton
items.description: Placeholder bars for a non-table list while its deferred prop loads. One job: Hold the space of a list that is still arriving.

items.name: load-error
items.title: LoadError
items.description: The fourth state of a data region: it did not load, and here is the button that tries again. One job: Say a region failed to load and offer one retry.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog
items.description: Title, one sentence of consequence, Keep it, and a button that names the verb. For the light status changes. One job: Stop a one-click state change long enough to read what it does.

items.name: reason-dialog
items.title: ReasonDialog
items.description: A confirm with a required reason, and a typed name for deletes. The reason lands in the audit log. One job: Make every serious change say why before it happens.

items.name: form-dialog
items.title: FormDialog
items.description: A dialog that is a form: title, your fields, Cancel and a submit that names the object. One job: Create or rename a small record without leaving the page.

items.name: phone-field
items.title: PhoneField
items.description: The one phone input: country selector, as-you-type formatting, E.164 out, Somalia first. One job: Collect one valid phone number in international form.

items.name: password-input
items.title: PasswordInput
items.description: A password input with a show / hide toggle that stays out of the tab order. One job: Collect a password the user can check before submitting.

items.name: remote-combobox
items.title: RemoteCombobox
items.description: A searchable picker whose options come from the server as you type. One job: Pick one record from a list too long to send with the page.

items.name: verify-phone-dialog
items.title: VerifyPhoneDialog
items.description: Fixed title, the phone, "Send code", then six digits and one confirm. One job: Prove a phone number belongs to the person in front of the screen.

items.name: saved-views-menu
items.title: SavedViewsMenu
items.description: Saved filter sets for a list. The menu knows which one is active by comparing the URL. One job: Save the current query of a list under a name and return to it in one click.

items.name: favorite-button
items.title: FavoriteButton
items.description: A star that pins any viewable record or saved view to the sidebar. One job: Toggle one record in the user's favorites.

items.name: export-button
items.title: ExportButton
items.description: A plain download link styled as an outline button. Exports what the list shows. One job: Download the current list as CSV.

items.name: csv-import
items.title: CsvImport
items.description: Pick a file, preview what would change, then import. Nothing writes before the preview. One job: Import records from CSV with a dry run first.

items.name: setup-checklist
items.title: SetupChecklist
items.description: Steps that tick from real data, each with a link to where it gets done, and one "Finish setup". One job: Walk the super admin through the first configuration without storing a single tick.

items.name: onboarding-card
items.title: OnboardingCard
items.description: The side card on a record born from an onboarding: reference, who started it, who approved it, when, and the source. One job: Show where a relationship record came from.

items.name: insight-item
items.title: InsightItem
items.description: One insight: severity, title, body, folded evidence, suggestions you can apply, mark seen, dismiss. One job: Present one rule signal and let the reader act on it or close it.

items.name: block-index-page
items.title: Index page
items.description: PageHeader with its create action, FilterBar with export, one DataTable of typed cells, the pager.

items.name: block-record-page
items.title: Record page
items.description: Header actions, tabs that are routes, detail cards main-left and fixed-right, activity.

items.name: block-form-page
items.title: Full-page form
items.description: Sticky header with Cancel and Create, section cards left, fixed-field cards right.

items.name: block-home-dashboard
items.title: Home
items.description: Raised stat tiles, the work waiting on you as a table, latest activity.

items.name: template-users-page
items.title: Organization · Users
items.description: The people list inside the Organization section: invite in a dialog, deactivate with a reason.

items.name: template-trash-page
items.title: Trash
items.description: What was deleted, by whom, why, and how many days remain. Restore through a confirm.

items.name: template-setup-page
items.title: Organization · Setup
items.description: The checklist that ticks from real data, the services panel, and Finish setup.

items.name: template-settings-page
items.title: Settings · Profile
items.description: The personal settings layout: profile, timezone and quiet hours, nothing platform-wide.
